join hortbot 999 foobar 1

clock_set 2000-10-01T03:11:00Z

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add repeatme Hello there! (_MESSAGE_COUNT_)
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme' added, restricted to subscribers and above.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!schedule add repeatme @hourly
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme' has been scheduled with '@hourly' and will run if at least 1 message has passed.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :hey
no_send

checkpoint
clock_forward 48m
no_send

checkpoint
clock_forward 15m
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Hello there! 3

checkpoint
clock_forward 62m
sleep 100ms
no_send


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command delete repeatme
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme' and its repeat/schedule have been deleted.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :hey
no_send

checkpoint
clock_forward 62m
sleep 100ms
no_send


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!schedule on repeatme
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme' does not exist.
